intent.responsibility: Own one complete video-call Screen whose participant roles determine the current composition.
intent.visualBoundary: Own system chrome, optional header, direct participant surfaces/media/fallbacks, main overlay rows and optional call controls.
intent.runtimeBehavior: Runtime owns call title, control states and one ordered participant collection whose animated role selects main, PIP or grid presentation.
intent.forwarding: Forward participant media, avatar and fallback status explicitly to their fixed Component Variants; project main overlay rows through the shared row contract.
intent.temporalOwnership: The Screen owns participant presence; every participant Runtime field is resolved relative to that participant first appearance.
intent.productionContext: Use exact Screen → Shot → Actor → Theme/Device context.
